name: Beginnings
summary: In Dun Morogh, Alliance warlock novices face their first trial under Alamar Grimm. They gather magical feather charms from Frostmane troll novices before learning to summon an imp.

sections.title: A Reluctant Mentor
sections.body: At Anvilmar, dark magic is tolerated out of necessity, though it is not openly celebrated. Alamar Grimm, an established warlock, pursues occult research in relative discretion. When a recruit shows raw promise, influential voices take an interest. Their pressure convinces Grimm to leave his studies and assess the novice himself.

sections.title: The Spark of Dark Magic
sections.body: Before teaching a novice to enslave lesser demons, Grimm demands proof of physical endurance and magical affinity. Frostmane troll novices gather in a cave southwest of Anvilmar, carrying primitive feather charms infused with subtle primal magic. The novice must defeat these magical adversaries and take their charms. The trial proves the novice can overcome a magical foe, while giving Grimm curious specimens for his research.

sections.title: Summoning the Imp
sections.body: The charms satisfy Grimm that the novice has sufficient will to survive. He then teaches the summoning of an imp, the warlock's most basic minion. Grimm warns that an imp's small size hides chaotic fire magic, and an undisciplined master can easily be overpowered.

faq.answer: Alamar Grimm gives the trial. He is a warlock trainer inside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Dun Morogh.

faq.q: What are the feather charms used for?
faq.answer: The feather charms prove an aspiring warlock can face and defeat magically adept enemies. They are enchanted troll trinkets that give Alamar Grimm curious specimens to examine in his research.

faq.q: Where are the Frostmane novices located?
faq.answer: Frostmane troll novices gather in a cave southwest of Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, where the Frostmane trolls have established a presence.

faq.q: What reward does a warlock gain upon completing this task?
faq.answer: The trial earns Alamar Grimm's approval and teaches a warlock to summon an imp, their first demonic companion.

faq.q: Why is Alamar Grimm teaching new warlocks?
aliases: who told alamar to train me
faq.answer: Influential voices take an interest in the fledgling warlock, convincing Grimm to pause his private occult studies and test and mentor the recruit.

faq.q: Is the imp dangerous for a novice warlock?
faq.answer: Yes. Alamar Grimm warns that an imp's small size hides volatile fel fire and cunning, and an inexperienced summoner can easily be overpowered by one.

angles.text: As an Alliance warlock, this is your defining first step in Dun Morogh, unlocking the ability to summon your first demonic servant.
As a gnome warlock learning your craft in Coldridge Valley, you must prove your intellect and magical dominance by outsmarting the local Frostmane trolls.
